newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: SOCCER-AUSTRIANS AND CZECHS DISCUSS JOINT EURO 2004 BID.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AUSTRIANS AND CZECHS DISCUSS JOINT EURO 2004 BID.

text.p: Austrian Football Federation President Beppo Mauhart and his Czech counterpart Frantisek Chvalovsky said they were confident their two countries could mount a joint bid to host the European soccer championships in 2004.
The Austrian news agency APA reported that Mauhart and Chvalovsky, who met in Vienna on Friday evening, believed a bid was possible if both governments agreed to financial support.
The two men said their governments would be reminded that the deadline to announce any financial support for the bid was April 30, APA said.
Spain are considered a possible frontrunner in the race to host the 2004 tournament. The sport's governing body UEFA is expected to make a decision in 1998.
In the year 2000, Belgium and the Netherlands will become the first joint hosts for the tournament.
